statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats
The patient has suspected cardiac arrhythmia associated with diagnosis code I49.9
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The cardiac event monitoring study is medically necessary
The procedure is essential for identifying the specific nature of the arrhythmia and guiding appropriate clinical management
